# RPS_B / RPS_E paired capture decision — 2026-09-17

**AI disclosure:** This report and its prose were generated by AI at the repository
owner's request. Maintainer self-review; no independent second review is claimed.
Research leaf [companion #53](https://github.com/iconidentify/omarchy-m1-video/issues/53)
feeds [driver #42](https://github.com/iconidentify/libva-v4l2_request/issues/42).

Both clients select the same logical reference pictures for every slice in these
captures. RPS_B is correct; RPS_E remains corrupt. The first corrupt picture in
GStreamer's **decode order** is POC 28, immediately after the CRA picture POC 32;
VA's is POC 31. DPB slot layouts differ, including in the entirely correct RPS_B
control. This narrows the next source investigation to AVD's reference-table and
collocated-motion state across random access. **It does not establish causation,
a kernel/firmware defect, or a fix. HEVC support remains 144/147.**

## Captured result

All ten short, serial guarded runs completed 300 hardware-decoded frames each,
with successful child status and final idle state. Frame-by-frame hashes and
whole-stream hashes agree exactly between trace-off, trace-on and supplemental
runs of each client/vector. There was one owner-authorized unload/load of the
existing module before the campaign, after saved-work/closed-app confirmation.
The prior six fault markers were retained; the fixed post-recovery boundary was
not advanced between runs. No new fault or wedge occurred. No module was installed,
no source patch was changed, and no further reload was attempted.

| Vector / client | Correct / complete output | Full-stream MD5 | First wrong displayed output / POC | Earliest wrong decode picture / POC |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| RPS_B / VA | 300/300 | `6d1ed392b067050ebd3a24a37281da03` | none | none |
| RPS_B / direct V4L2 | 300/300 | `6d1ed392b067050ebd3a24a37281da03` | none | none |
| RPS_E / VA | 274/300 | `b09ac8e0bd31a96d8354505d7c2ebdd5` | 31 / 31 | 31 / 31 |
| RPS_E / direct V4L2 | 275/300 | `53952960ec7512d9cb64f8c7020ece03` | 26 / 26 | 29 / 28 |

RPS_E reference MD5 is `c30d38bbd7ea483dc7ffe81325118e16`. Fresh software
references matched the authoritative full-stream hashes for both vectors. Output
indices are zero-based; decode pictures are one-based accepted request order.
GStreamer's first wrong displayed output belongs to decode picture **32**, not 26.
All full wrong-frame sets and all 300 per-frame hashes per run are retained in
[results.json](results.json) and [reference-frames.json](reference-frames.json).
These are frame counts for two vectors, not new passing-vector totals.

## Association and evidence custody

VA used a local build of driver `266269ee49d2fbb147f4983307b4b2492bd1a829`, selected
with `LIBVA_DRIVERS_PATH`; it was not installed. Its `frame-check.c` helper had one
change, `AV_LOG_WARNING` to `AV_LOG_DEBUG`. Hardware mode requires actual VA frames;
software fallback is not counted. Native 416×240 I420 frame hashes were retained.

FFmpeg's [`refs.c`](https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/blob/bf1b838f2ab88b4f8fd83443325c782ea0e0f7fa/libavcodec/hevc/refs.c)
logs `Output frame with POC layer/poc` after successful output FIFO insertion.
The first integer is the layer, not an epoch. Each selected log has exactly 300
unique layer-zero POCs, 0–299. These map to the unique POCs in the accepted VA
reference trace, with 300 successful helper outputs. No output/request-order
identity assumption is used.

GStreamer uses the pinned timestamp-to-system-frame-number mapping described in
[the source map](../../source-map.json). Its output event occurs before completion
checks, so the association also requires successful actual pipeline exit and
exactly 44,928,000 bytes of raw I420 output. Both selected runs satisfy those checks
and have all 300 unique output events and completed request lifecycles.

The initial eight runs used `GST_DEBUG=v4l2codecs:6`, which did not emit the HEVC
output events. Those four GStreamer runs retain their complete pixel/control
results but **have no output association**. Two supplemental runs used the correct
`GST_DEBUG="v4l2codecs*:6"`; their matching complete pixels and output logs supply
the selected associations. They were taken while the decoder remained idle/free,
within the same ten-minute window, with the same fixed fault boundary and finite
guards. The initial limitation is recorded, not silently filled from another run.

Published files contain reference metadata, hashes, redacted successful guard
records, association maps and provenance. Original licensed bitstreams, raw tracer
JSON, decoded YUV and verbose client logs remain private and unchanged. Raw tracer
JSON includes compressed media, paths, memory addresses and uninitialized bytes;
it must not be redistributed. [private-artifacts.json](private-artifacts.json)
records their sizes/hashes for local custody. Hashes alone do not allow an external
reviewer to verify private contents. Whole-stream MD5s are captured measurements;
they cannot be recomputed from individual frame MD5s.

## What differs, and what agrees

The strict checker first reports a DPB source difference on RPS_B picture 15 / POC
13, and an `lt_curr` ordering difference on RPS_E picture 9 / POC 4. These are
recorded differences, not attributed failures. See [summary.json](summary.json).

Resolving each slot to its unique picture POC over all 300 pictures gives:

| Recorded comparison | RPS_B differing pictures | RPS_E differing pictures |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DPB membership, long-term flags and field flags | 0 | 0 |
| Effective slice L0/L1 and collocated picture identities | 0 | 0 |
| POC, IRAP, IDR, long-term SPS flag, total current count | 0 | 0 |
| Short-term before/after lists | 0 | 0 |
| Long-term current list order | 0 | 69 (first POC 4) |
| DPB slot order | 239 (first POC 13) | 271 (first POC 16) |

I-slice unused collocated metadata remains in the strict trace but is excluded
from logical reference selection: the pinned AVD function returns before using it.
No timestamps, reused buffers or repeated POCs are silently collapsed: the strict
checker first validates earlier-writer identity, and this report separately
requires 300 unique POCs and complete association maps.

At GStreamer's earliest wrong decode picture (29 / POC 28), both clients use
L0/L1 `[32,16]` and collocated POC 32. The preceding decode picture is CRA POC 32.
At VA's earliest wrong decode picture (31 / POC 31), both use L0 `[30,28]`,
L1 `[32,30]` and collocated POC 30. These referenced VA outputs are still correct.

## AVD source lead and next bounded experiment

Pinned [`hevc.c`](https://github.com/AsahiLinux/linux/blob/94fb23346d522edf53722357c426a3e58030beea/drivers/media/platform/apple/avd/hevc.c)
from tag `asahi-7.1.13-3` shows:

- `stream_refs()` emits firmware reference headers and buffer addresses in submitted
  DPB order, including long-term flags and POC deltas.
- `stream_slice_dqtblk()` emits explicit L0/L1 DPB slot indices.
- `stream_slice_mv()` resolves the collocated timestamp and gates motion-vector
  use on the reference buffer's `hevc.is_intra` state, among other flags.
- This command builder does **not** read `poc_lt_curr`. Reordering that list because
  it is the first strict difference is not a justified correction.

Next, build an **offline source-derived map** from these public records to the
reference/header/list words and symbolic motion-buffer state around decode
pictures 24–34, retaining the complete preceding history and RPS_B control. Name
unknown fields explicitly and identify the smallest kernel instrumentation needed
to distinguish slot mapping, buffer reuse and colocated-state hypotheses. A model
is a prediction, not a captured firmware command. Any later kernel edit or new
hardware experiment needs its own scoped authorization and guarded evidence.

Complete SPS/PPS, weights, entry points, compressed payload and all firmware inputs
have not been compared. Client allocation/state differences and other unrecorded
inputs remain possible explanations. DPB permutation alone is demonstrably
insufficient evidence because RPS_B also has permutations with exact output.
No speculative workaround or reorder is enabled. Parent #42 retains the actual
cause/fix, three isolated exact RPS_E runs, RPS_B preservation, all 147 vectors,
and fault/concurrency qualification.

## Reproduce the offline decision

Use Python 3 and a trusted checkout of driver checker commit
`ba66572ff7e1e380377eb2414a7eb7d7f97bb0d9` (merged through
[driver PR #91](https://github.com/iconidentify/libva-v4l2_request/pull/91)).
From the companion repository root:

```sh
export HEVC_REFTRACE_CHECKER=/absolute/driver/tests/hevc-reftrace-check.py
python3 experiments/hevc-controls/tests.py
python3 experiments/hevc-controls/report-tests.py
python3 experiments/hevc-controls/report.py experiments/hevc-controls/captures/2026-09-17 --verify
```

The report validates published counts, statuses, guard identities/times, selected
runs, all four complete reference traces, output associations and trace-on/off
pixel equality, then recomputes the wrong sets and comparison summary. It verifies
metadata consistency, not the authenticity of private raw artifacts or a new
hardware run. Negative tests alter an output hash, guard outcome, input identity,
association and selected run; duplicate runs and optimized-Python bypass attempts
must also fail.

For a separately authorized reproduction, use the [guarded recipe](../../README.md#future-guarded-capture-recipe-not-run-by-these-tests)
and preserve actual child status under the pinned tracer. The original campaign
used 90-second deadlines for the first eight runs and 45 seconds for the two
supplemental runs, 0.1-second guard polling and the recovery boundary in
[provenance.json](provenance.json). Input SHA-256 values are recorded per run.
[commands.json](commands.json) retains the captured argv with named path placeholders
and explicit environment/guard options from retained runner scripts and session/guard
records. Supplemental direct-V4L2 runs did not select a libva driver path. It is not
a complete dump of the inherited process environment.
[recovery.json](recovery.json) records the single approved recovery. Provenance
includes exact package revisions, userspace/module/helper binary hashes and
external source pins. Selected module file hashes and the matching checked-in
patch stamp do not independently prove resident kernel text or a reproducible
module build. This is one M1 and two vectors, not a soak, performance, boot or
multi-device qualification.
